explication: 7-Zip ZS is a 7-Zip fork that adds compression codecs, encryption methods, and hashers, distributed either as a complete GUI/Explorer setup or as a codec plugin. The principal workflow is a user invoking the CLI or GUI to open or create an archive, which delegates format handling and compression or encryption before extracting or writing files. The README documents the added capabilities; sampled sources show CLI and extraction behavior, but not the full codec and archive dispatch paths, so those links are marked unverified where needed.
